title: Video
description: A video shown to whoever reads: where it is (`src`) — a file the browser plays, or the page of a host that embeds its own player (YouTube, Vimeo) —, what it is called for whoever cannot watch it, and a caption when there is something to say under it.

src.description: Where the video is: a file, or a host's page for it.

title.description: What the video is, said to whoever cannot watch it.

caption.description: What is said under the video, when there is something to say.

poster.description: A picture shown before it plays.
